title: Improve LLM-as-a-Judge Ability as a General Ability

bias_targets.methodology: Swapping the order of chosen and rejected candidate answers during data synthesis and requiring the model to consistently select the correct answer regardless of its position to filter out biased judgments.

Balancing the constructed dataset so that the chosen and rejected answers have an equal probability of being the longer response, and explicitly prompting the model to not let response length influence its evaluation.
